callees.name: _phase_plan_schema_errors
callees.pre_condition: phases_path is a string path that may refer to any existing, missing, or unreadable file
callees.post_condition: Returns a value that is falsy when and only when the file at phases_path exists, is readable, contains syntactically valid JSON, and the content conforms to the required phases plan schema. Returns a truthy value otherwise, indicating the file is missing, unreadable, contains malformed JSON, or does not conform to the required schema structure.
